source_authority.document: Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
loci: Chapter 4 Theorem 1.2 states that there exist finitely generated ICC property-(T) groups Lambda, Gamma_0, Gamma_1, ... that are pairwise nonisomorphic and satisfy L(Gamma_n) isomorphic to L(Lambda) for every n>=0.
Corollary 5.10 states that Lambda and Gamma_0 are nonisomorphic ICC property-(T) groups with isomorphic group von Neumann algebras.
Section 2.1 defines L(G) from the left regular representation and the canonical trace tau_G(x)=<x delta_1, delta_1>; Section 2.2 defines property (T) through almost invariant unit vectors.

Proposition 4.3 and Proposition 6.3 obtain the factor isomorphisms from a common measured K-action / measure-preserving crossed-product presentation. The displayed theorem and corollary say isomorphic group von Neumann algebras; they do not separately print the phrases trace-preserving or normal star-algebra isomorphism.

The proof of Theorem 1.2 derives pairwise nonisomorphism, ICC, property (T), finite generation, and L(Gamma_n) isomorphic to L(Lambda); pairwise factor isomorphism L(Gamma_m) isomorphic to L(Gamma_n) is a direct transitivity consequence rather than a separately displayed source clause.

definition_concordance.namespace_identity: The current registered declarations are exactly the two ConnesRigidity.* targets in the successor config. definition_concordance.countable_group_and_icc: CountableDiscreteGroup stores a group carrier together with Countable. IsICC requires Infinite G and an infinite conjugacy class for every nonidentity element, matching the manuscript's countable discrete ICC convention.
definition_concordance.group_isomorphism: GroupsIsomorphic G H is Nonempty (G ≃* H), the standard abstract group-isomorphism relation used by the source's pairwise-nonisomorphism assertions.
definition_concordance.property_t: HasKazhdanPropertyT uses unitary representations, almost invariant unit vectors on every finite test set and positive epsilon, and a nonzero invariant vector. The challenge quantifies Hilbert carriers H : Type u in the same universe as G; for the registered Type 0 groups this is a universe-scoped formal encoding. This audit does not claim a separate universe-polymorphic equivalence theorem, so the source property-(T) result is used only to justify the registered scoped target predicate.
definition_concordance.group_von_neumann_algebra_and_trace: groupVonNeumannAlgebra is the bicommutant/centralizer-centralizer closure of the left regular representation on l2(G). canonicalTrace is the vacuum vector state at delta_1, matching the source formulas L(G)=lambda_G(G)'' and tau_G(x)=<x delta_1,delta_1>.
definition_concordance.factor_isomorphism_structure: TracialGroupFactorEquiv packages a complex star-algebra equivalence, preservation of the formal IsProjectionSupremum predicate in both directions, and canonical-trace preservation. The solution constructs this from PaperFactorUnitaryWitness: a unitary spatial equivalence that maps the group-factor algebras and the vacuum vector. Its trace_preserving theorem follows from vacuum preservation. The solution also proves starAlgEquiv_isNormal for the chosen projection-supremum predicate. Thus the formal structure is a source-construction-faithful spatial/tracial refinement of the manuscript's factor-isomorphism conclusion, not verbatim theorem wording and not an independently audited equivalence with every analytic definition of normality.
definition_concordance.finite_generation: Group.FG is the pinned Mathlib finitely-generated-group predicate. Theorem 1.2 explicitly states finite generation, and the manuscript proof notes that the countable property-(T) groups are finitely generated.
definition_concordance.infinite_family_quantifiers: The infinite target quantifies one Lambda and a sequence Gamma : Nat -> CountableDiscreteGroup, requires all finite-generation/ICC/property-(T) fields, factor isomorphism Gamma_n -> Lambda for every n, pairwise nonisomorphism of distinct Gamma_m/Gamma_n, and Lambda nonisomorphic to every Gamma_n. Its additional all-pairs factor-isomorphism field is derived by symmetry and transitivity through Lambda.

claim_boundary: This candidate is limited to current-root semantic/nonvacuity classification of the two registered OTP-E-CONNES-RIGIDITY targets. It records the source ICC and property-(T) conventions, the left-regular group von Neumann algebra and canonical trace, and the source's finitely generated pairwise-nonisomorphic family with common group factor. The audit does not claim that trace-preserving or normal star-algebra isomorphism is printed verbatim in Theorem 1.2/Corollary 5.10, does not identify the internal normality predicate with every analytic normality notion, and does not claim a universe-polymorphic property-(T) equivalence beyond the registered scoped predicate. The infinite target's all-pairs Gamma factor-isomorphism field is a symmetry/transitivity consequence through Lambda, not a separately printed source clause. This candidate creates no MATHSOLVE handoff, MATHCERT route/output, proof certification, mathematical-proof promotion, whole-chapter equivalence, or aggregate OpenAI Ten Proofs authority.
